scope: SPDK source semantics to declared research hardware or closed-loop model

actual_configuration.reason: This worker has no independent runtime metadata receipt; requested settings are not execution proof.

provenance.source_review: Directed critical SPDK callback/count/drain passages and existing RTL source boundaries; no duplicate full literature or VFIO investigation.

recommendation.go_now_for_root_consideration: clockless finite completion-driven source semantic prototype; no service timing or performance outputs
recommendation.preference_reason: There is no usable real event file in this seat's input. A prototype makes the legal projection, generations, QD, feedback and finite end executable; a checker without events would only repeat missing-evidence findings.
recommendation.input_sensitive_alternative: If the independent evidence seat obtains a usable real event slice, first check its actual schema, generations, success/error/phase/retry/drain and mark missing buffer/IOVA/device bindings. This checker must not output D performance.
recommendation.go_conditionally_later: small declared service model only after provider/resources/action/observation/full costs and falsifiers are frozen
do_not_enter_yet: fixed M0 parameter expansion, phase/gap tuning, guard weakening or new collector
recommendation.authorization_effect: root has separately admitted and dispatched the clockless semantic prototype; this design seat starts no implementation or experiment

current_admission.root_provided_test_parameters: N=4,QD=2, exhaustive callback orders with independent replay and mutations; finite semantic test only
conditional_performance_pending_specific: host transport direction and command/CQ stages
O0 and candidate signal first visibility

evidence_levels.M: explicitly declared model projection and proposed hardware interfaces
evidence_levels.N: identity-bound native deployment and end-to-end measured performance

preserved_old_gate.general_admission_revision_proposed: S-to-M may posit research hardware actions and explicit service hypotheses; native action availability and measured opposite signs are not universal model prerequisites.

minimal_source_contract.subset: one namespace, one worker, sequential pure reads, metadata absent, count-limited; two independent copies are declared research owners, not an observed joint deployment
minimal_source_contract.parameters: N_i >= Q_i >= 1; byte size, page size, mapping, tags and pool are symbolic/public
minimal_source_contract.identity: owner, task slot, generation, buffer and declared mapping_id
minimal_source_contract.acceptance: successful submission increments accepted and in-flight; rejected submission has no successful work
minimal_source_contract.completion: payload/protocol completion then successful CQ visibility and poll/callback; errors separate
minimal_source_contract.resubmit: same task and buffer on callback while not draining; per-action feedback recomputed
minimal_source_contract.finite_end: exactly N accepted and N succeeded per owner, no failures/duplicates/lost generations, no outstanding/held offers, protocols retired, CQ consumed, tasks freed, joint quiet
minimal_source_contract.error_subset: error-free runs only for performance comparisons; failed submissions/CQ errors invalidate and remain visible; real runs stopping by time/signal before N are incomplete

paths.name: event semantics then optional service model
paths.current_step: clockless source state machine and conservation checks only
later_debt: explicit persistent service provider and boundary transition
timely paid observation and complete costs
paths.current_claim_limit: semantic projection and closed-loop correctness; no cycles, throughput, P/PN sign or device persistence

paths.name: private source adapter around actual IOMMU RTL
paths.cost_reason: Must add one-way host DMA transactions, QD/tag correlation, CQ/command ordering, protocol backpressure, finite end and independent quiet/config/clear/warm; autonomous single-active COPY does not supply these.
paths.claim_limit: specified projected-source RTL protocol/cycle behavior, not native NVMe/SSD/MIG/Linux/application performance

state_pair.kind: predeclared falsifiable conditional reachability and decision-value contract
state_pair.positive_condition: source-feedback generated safe overlap advances the complete critical path more than all contention, tail and observation/control costs
state_pair.negative_condition: same public contract generates extra critical PTE/background delay or no useful early readiness so complete PN loss is larger
state_pair.generation_rule: same stateful service provider and parameter domain, frozen before outcomes; no chosen PTW phase, post-hoc seed/offset, future hit truth or copied counterfactual arrivals
state_pair.O0_constraint: full publicly available source/configuration/mapping/history information; indistinguishability must be checked, not assumed
state_pair.persistence_constraint: previous-window Z must remain predictive after drain/config/clear/warm; state existence and real persistence unmeasured
state_pair.reset_boundary: If the future model resets all relevant U deterministically or makes future loss conditionally independent of old Z given O0, previous-window information value is zero by the model's own construction. This does not refute real persistence. The clockless semantic prototype has no U/timing/Z and cannot adjudicate this question.
falsifiers: provider cannot generate pair without external phase forcing
full public O0 already selects the same action
no complete opposite-sign pair in the registered service class
ordinary paid trial or structural controls match the claimed increment

ordinary_controls: full O0 plus public structure and completion history
legal QD adjustment, resident pool, preparation, reuse and pacing
legal supported large pages and contiguous mappings with complete costs
paid trials with complete work, time, state perturbation and cleanup
same paid new interface supplied to ordinary policy to distinguish interface value from policy value
unknown_not_set_to_zero: real buffer/IOVA/device binding and translated shared topology
real endpoint service state, transitions and predictive distribution

novelty.positive_candidate: source-faithful complete closed-loop conditions for existing-information sufficiency or a costed minimal new observation interface
novelty.requires: root critical evidence review and substantive closest-work comparison
